Advisory dispositions (folded into held-out oracle + implementer brief, not re-edited into plan to avoid re-staling the cert): adv1 acquire_lock contention contract — returns lock_key|None, and on a non-stale 412 re-raises ClientError; doctor treats BOTH None and raised-ClientError as 'repair in flight -> back off' (test both). adv2 branch placement — check _is_multi_bundle FIRST in the failure handler, before _is_non_fast_forward, so it is intercepted whether classified retriable or terminal. adv3 capture merged tip as an immutable SHA (git rev-parse) under write_lock at end of fold. adv4 verified init_remote_head(ref) is idempotent (no-op when HEAD exists; stores ref NAME); the single-bundle collapse is what disambiguates the ref, so no HEAD rewrite needed. adv6 credential-less contract test pins the v0.3.2 API surface (verified against installed source this session). adv5 (ADR/AGENTS.md note for the private-API decision) -> carried to docs story b014.
